# TechFiyr

> TechFiyr is a mobile app and web software development agency based in Mirpur DOHS, Dhaka, Bangladesh. We design, build and ship Flutter, React Native, iOS and Android apps, custom web software and SaaS platforms, UI/UX and product prototypes, and backend, cloud and CI/CD pipelines for startups and growing businesses in the United States, Europe and Asia. Rated 5.0 on Fiverr.

Key facts:

- Company: TechFiyr (mobile app and web software agency)
- Location: 325, Mirpur DOHS, Dhaka 1216, Bangladesh. Works remotely with clients worldwide.
- Contact: info@techfiyr.com, WhatsApp +880 1540659530 (https://wa.me/8801540659530), or book a free 30-minute discovery call at https://techfiyr.com/contact.html
- Track record: 2+ years shipping mobile and web products, 20 clients across the US, Europe and Asia, 5.0 average client rating on Fiverr, a core team of 5 designers and developers.
- Founder: Saurav Wahid, Founder & Mobile DevOps Lead, Oracle Certified Professional with 11+ years of software engineering experience.
- Co-founders: Viswajit Roy (Lead UI/UX Designer, 10+ years of product design experience) and Ponir Saha (Co-Founder & CTO).
- Hire through: the website, Fiverr (https://www.fiverr.com/wahidsaurav) or Upwork (https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/sauravwahid).

## Services

- Mobile App Design & Development: Flutter, React Native, native iOS and Android, App Store and Google Play deployment.
- Custom Web Software & SaaS: Next.js, React, Node.js, admin dashboards, cloud SaaS platforms.
- UI/UX & Product Prototyping: Figma design, mobile UI/UX, design systems, wireframes.
- Backend, Cloud & CI/CD Pipelines: REST and GraphQL APIs, Firebase, AWS, Codemagic CI/CD, mobile DevOps and store release automation.

## How we work

1. Discovery & Architecture: requirements, user journeys and a scalable technical foundation.
2. UI/UX & Interactive Design: Figma prototypes and design systems.
3. Agile Sprint Development: Flutter, React and Next.js apps with clean, modular code and secure APIs.
4. QA, Deployment & Scale: end-to-end testing, App Store, Google Play and cloud deployment, and post-launch support.

## Projects

- [MatMaps](https://techfiyr.com/project.html?p=matmaps): a UK combat sports platform (Android and web) that helps athletes find clubs and events and gives gym owners tools to run their club. Live on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.matmaps.app) and at https://matmaps.co.uk/.
